name: Porch lights
summary: The friends' windows at dusk: tap yours to turn your light on if you're up for something; at three lights Muse offers the cheapest thing those three wanted this week and you lock it.
useWhen: Friday night, nobody has a plan: 'anyone doing anything', 'what's everyone up to tonight'
a low-pressure check of who's up for something, where staying in is fine
dontUseWhen: a plan already picked that needs RSVPs (use an event)
choosing between named options (use a poll or slot-machine)
finding a date weeks out (use meeting-time)

params.title: string
params.sub: string, the moment: 'Fri 6:12pm · light on = up for something'
params.need: number 2-6, lights it takes to offer a plan
params.windows: 2-8 x {name, place (building; consecutive windows group), on, said (their line), want (something they wanted this week), cost (cents), cat}
